reason: I've already paid a 'registration fee' to a fake agency once, so a beta app asking ₹499 upfront makes me nervous, even if a café I know sent the link. I might try the free first collab, but I'm not paying for the pass until I've actually been paid through it.
objection: Auto-DM could get my account flagged or shadowbanned by Instagram, and my account is my whole income. Also, the café gets ₹150 if I pay, so their invite feels a bit like they're selling to me, and I'd have to make promo videos on top of that.
would_change_my_mind: Finishing the free collab and actually getting paid on time, plus proof that Auto-DM uses Instagram's official API and won't get my account flagged.
